$comment: Cases both editors must judge alike, in the format of kotlin.json: the modifiers a DSL call sets in its lambda and the expressions it is handed, as the DSL and the client read them.

cases.name: modifiers the DSL refuses as it renders

issues.message: Streamlord throws at render: leading needs duration, which is not set.
Streamlord throws at render: threshold must be between 0 and 100.
Streamlord throws at render: half, full and threshold are alternatives; set one.
Streamlord throws at render: debounceLeading needs debounce, which is not set.
Streamlord throws at render: duration must be positive, not 0s.

cases.name: a computed in the DSL that changes a signal

issues.message: data-computed must not change signals, and this changes $count: Datastar runs it again each time a signal it reads changes. Use data-effect for a side effect.
